product.objective: Address the verified DogdouSpec usage-report defects and missing public entries in an isolated worktree; preserve governance semantics and defer product design decisions.

index.summary: Verified CLI fixes, public authoring/read entries, documentation and regression evidence.

deliverable.description: Safe additive mutations, timestamp handling, truthful previews and finish receipts; history, check, backlog and iteration-content entries; installed guidance and regression tests.

included.item: DogdouSpec CLI/Core, schemas only where required for supported inputs, tests, embedded skill, bootstrap, contracts and installation/upgrade guidance in the isolated worktree.

index.summary: Fix verified usability defects and expose existing capabilities without weakening governance.

requirement.statement: Implement the explicit repairs and entry improvements approved in the owner request of 2026-10-27, as bounded by this iteration acceptance and excluded product decisions.
requirement.rationale: The assessed usage report contains reproducible defects and discovery failures; fixes must be independently testable and isolated from the main checkout rebuild.

acceptance.criterion: Same- and cross-iteration dependencies have correct scope; adding scope preserves existing repositories, includes, exclusions and concurrent revision protection.
Far-future explicit timestamps fail without mutation while generated task operations remain monotonic, including legacy future metadata and replay.
Transaction dry-run is public and read-only; all previews identify themselves; finish reports each applied transition and the complete revision range.
Task records can be selected by last count, kind and fields with explicit truncation; XPath files avoid shell conversion and empty query diagnostics are opt-in.
Task record accepts existing structured check evidence; backlog helpers generate optional identities, attribution and time without weakening explicit replay or open kind semantics.
A public content input creates complete draft iteration intent atomically without a placeholder rewrite, while product approval gates stay intact.
Help, embedded skill, bootstrap guidance, public contracts and fresh/upgrade resources describe all new entries; full build passes with zero warnings and errors.

constraints.constraint: Implement and validate only in L:/dogdouspec-usage-repairs; preserve the original checkout for its separate rebuild.
Preserve raw request schemas, exact revision checks, owner decisions and independent review gates; defer unresolved product design to backlog.
